company.name: CoachHub
company.shortDescription: CoachHub is a leading global AI and digital coaching platform to enable enterprises in scaling coaching across their wordwide workforce
company.description: CoachHub is a leading global AI and digital coaching platform that enables organizations to scale personalized, measurable, and high quality coaching for the entire workforce, regardless of department and seniority level. CoachHub offers AI-enabled coaching, data-driven insights, and integration with HR systems to help organizations deliver effective coaching at scale. The platform allows for remote and online coaching sessions, making it accessible to employees across different locations.

aiResearchSummary.text: CoachHub is researching and developing a computer-implemented method of proposing a coach to a coachee, addressing the issue that a significant portion of employees find traditional training ineffective. The approach aims to enhance the effectiveness of digital coaching by matching coachees with suitable coaches, thereby supporting scalable coaching solutions for enterprise workforces.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $42,038,002, or 11.19% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,561,220 to $1,317,092,395, a 124.71x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 46 (-17 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
